## Findings
- claim-1: RWY Theorem 4.8 works integrally in \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) and gives two Schur generating families for \(J_v\), with \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\) and \(b=\min(i,j)\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 864-892]
- claim-2: RWY uses the vertical-strip Pieri rule \(e_k s_\lambda=\sum_\mu s_\mu\) and an induction with three shape-reduction steps to prove generation; the cited argument does not state Smith forms or determinantal-divisor certificates. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 1009-1041]
- claim-3: St. Dizier–Yong prove minimality of the lower-adjoined family \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\) in \(H^*(\mathrm{Gr}_{r,n})\cong\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\), under \(v=v_{r,s,t,n}\), \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-235]
- claim-4: Their proof reformulates possible syzygies using Littlewood–Richardson coefficient linear systems and a terminating coproduct-tensor reduction algorithm for valid \((n,r,i,j,a,b,N)\); it is not stated as a degreewise Pieri-matrix Smith-form or unimodular-minor procedure. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 294-340]
## Strategy
Compared the supplied full texts: RWY gives integral Schur-family generation, not Smith/minor certificates [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 864-892]; St. Dizier–Yong prove lower-family minimality via LR/coproduct reductions, not Pieri Smith forms [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-235; 294-340].

## Gaps
The required targeted external/arXiv keyword search for Smith normal forms, determinantal divisors, unimodular minors, and Pieri matrices was not executed in the supplied evidence and cannot be performed here. Therefore the requested target is **not established**. No bounded negative conclusion beyond the two inspected works is justified.
